cell_line.evidence: Here, we identified potential protein interaction partners of MINCH, as primary metabolite of the phthalate DEHP substitute DINCH, in the human SGBS adipocyte cell line.

cell_type.evidence: Here, we identified potential protein interaction partners of MINCH, as primary metabolite of the phthalate DEHP substitute DINCH, in the human SGBS adipocyte cell line.

developmental_stage.evidence: This study includes data on the thermal stability of proteins upon incubation of the cell lysates with 10 µM MINCH at day 4, an early, and day 12, the terminal day of adipocyte differentiation.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: The laboratory of Prof. Wabitsch at the University Hospital Ulm contributed Simpson–Golabi–Behmel syndrome (SGBS) cells.

tissue.evidence: inferred: Subcutaneous adipose tissue (SCAT) samples were collected during elective aesthetic and postbariatric surgery at the Division of Plastic, Aesthetic and Special Hand Surgery of the University Hospital Leipzig between January and July 2024.
